regime: Oil shock flaring again, with gold slipping ahead of the Fed
takeaway: Brent bounced back toward $115 after a Houthi strike claim on a Saudi refinery, keeping the oil-shock flag on. Gold gave back about half a percent to near $4,038 as higher oil revived inflation and rate-hike worries, and the 10-year yield edged back above 5%. Stock futures were mixed with tech slightly firmer; the Fed's 11 AM PT decision and the chair's comments can change this picture quickly.
